name: Register the moto and update the odometer
description: Verifies a signed-in user can register the moto and the new kilometraje persists.
setup: Sign in. If the moto registration form (Registra tu moto) is shown, fill Placa ABC12D, Cilindraje 163, Kilometraje actual 1200 and Fecha de matrícula 2025-06-01, then press Empezar. If the app is already registered, open Ajustes, set Kilometraje actual to 1200 under Mi moto and press Guardar cambios
steps: Type 1350 in the Nuevo kilometraje field and press Guardar
expected: The Inicio card shows 1.350 km as the current kilometraje after the refresh.

name: Reject a kilometraje lower than the current one
description: Verifies the app blocks an odometer reading lower than the last registered one.
setup: Sign in. If the moto registration form (Registra tu moto) is shown, fill Placa ABC12D, Cilindraje 163, Kilometraje actual 1200 and Fecha de matrícula 2025-06-01, then press Empezar. If the app is already registered, open Ajustes, set Kilometraje actual to 1200 under Mi moto and press Guardar cambios
steps: Type 1000 in the Nuevo kilometraje field and press Guardar
expected: A visible error says the kilometraje cannot be lower than the last registered value, and the current kilometraje shown is still 1.200 km.

name: Add and delete a SOAT document
description: Verifies documents can be added with an expiry date and deleted after confirmation, and that a 163 cc moto is classified for impuesto vehicular.
setup: Sign in. If the moto registration form (Registra tu moto) is shown, fill Placa ABC12D, Cilindraje 163, Kilometraje actual 1200 and Fecha de matrícula 2025-06-01, then press Empezar. If the app is already registered, open Ajustes, set Kilometraje actual to 1200 under Mi moto and press Guardar cambios
steps: Press Agregar, choose type SOAT, set name SOAT Prueba and Fecha de vencimiento 2030-01-15, press Guardar documento
Press the delete button for SOAT Prueba and confirm with Eliminar
Refresh the page and open the Legal tab
expected: The Legal tab shows the Impuesto vehicular (departamental) card and licencia A2, and SOAT Prueba is no longer listed after the refresh.

steps: Open the Gastos tab and keep the Gasolina view
Enter Kilometraje 5000, Galones 2, Total pagado 32000, keep Llené el tanque checked and press Guardar tanqueo
Enter Kilometraje 5300, Galones 3, Total pagado 48000, keep Llené el tanque checked and press Guardar tanqueo
Switch to Otros gastos, choose category Parqueadero, enter Valor 5000 and press Guardar gasto
